none: PAS NLM-5D2037: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian from Wickenby
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Reece period 19. Arles mint. Obverse description: Diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: [--]ALEN [--]AVG. Reverse description: Emperor with labarum dragging captive right. Reverse inscription: [---]ANORVM. In exergue: SCON, for Arles. Diameter: 17.4mm, Weight: 1.10gms, die axis: 6
